summary: Tested family member summary, shared loan creation, combined summary, and Health page badges/challenges. Backend tests all passed (9/9). Frontend tests verified shared loan toggle and Health page content. Fixed a bug in useIntelligenceData.js where undefined variables were used in family view.

family_member_summary_api.details: GET /api/family/member/{id}/summary returns frequency-normalized monthly income/expenses, effectiveFunds, survivalDays, savingsRate, totalEMI, counts

shared_loan_creation_api.details: POST /api/loans with sharedWithMembers creates loan and shared references for members

combined_summary_excludes_shared_refs.details: GET /api/family/combined-summary excludes isSharedReference loans from combined totals

loan_model_shared_fields.details: LoanCreate model accepts sharedWithMembers field (empty array and null)

health_page_badges_challenges.details: Health page shows badges ('Unlock Stability Bonus', 'Unlock new badge') and challenges ('HOW TO IMPROVE' section)

loan_form_shared_toggle.details: Loan form shows 'Share Loan with Family' toggle with data-testid='shared-loan-toggle'

family_view_selector.details: Health page has 'Personal' view selector for family switching

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: useIntelligenceData.js line 193 had undefined 'family_data' and 'totalInvestments' variables in family combined view - replaced with proper values from 'cs' (combined summary)
seed_data_creation: Created test loans and family members during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Family member summary, shared loans, and Health page badges/challenges all working. The shared loan toggle only shows family member checkboxes when toggled ON and family members exist. MPIN/Biometric setup modals may appear after login - click 'Skip' to dismiss.

bug_fixed.issue: Used undefined 'family_data' and 'totalInvestments' variables in family combined view
bug_fixed.fix: Replaced with 'cs.totalInvestments || 0' and default incomeSources value
